_comment: What each invitation said in 1.122.18, recorded through WPCPM_Mail::welcome_email() by bin/test-invitation-text.php --record before the invitations moved into the template registry. Invented names, example.test addresses and a fake key. Never edit by hand: the registry is held to these bytes.

student-7-1.subject: [WordPress Credits] Welcome to the WordPress Credits Program
student-7-1.message:
You have been enrolled on the WordPress Credits Program, and this is your account on the program site. Your program details, your mentor and your report form all live there.

Set your password using the link below, then check your details and book your first call with your mentor.

To set your password, visit the following address:

https://example.test/wp-login.php?login=ada.example&key=TEST-KEY-NOT-A-REAL-LINK&action=rp

The link above sets your password and stops working after a day. Your username is ada.example.

After that, sign in at the login page. If the password link has expired, open the login page, choose "Lost your password?" and enter your username or email address to get a fresh one.
https://example.test/wp-login.php

Each new invitation or password email replaces the link in the ones before it, so if you have more than one, use the newest.

Your Student Report Card:
https://example.test/student-report-card/
